mechanism: Both berberine and voriconazole are metabolized by CYP3A4; voriconazole inhibition of CYP3A4 may increase berberine concentrations, while berberine's CYP3A4 induction may decrease voriconazole efficacy.
action: Monitor for berberine toxicity (GI effects, diarrhea) and voriconazole efficacy; consider therapeutic drug monitoring of voriconazole or dose adjustment if clinically significant interaction suspected.
